```{r, libraries}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(suncalc)
library(FSA)
```

```{r, ImportData}
#| echo: false
#Import beaked whale detections
detections_summary<-readRDS(here('_data','BeakedWhales','Detections_summary.rds'))
# Acoustic study of all beaked whale detections
data <-readRDS(here('_data','BeakedWhales','CombinedStudy_EventswRecordingsGPS.rds'))
# Click detection data
detections<-readRDS(here('_data','BeakedWhales','Detections.rds'))

#Remove Unidentified beaked whale event
detections_summary<-detections_summary %>% filter(species!='UNME')
data<-data %>% filter(species!='UNME')
detections<-detections %>% filter(species!='UNME')

#Import deployment info
deployment_info<-readRDS(here('_data','BeakedWhales','Deployment_info.rds'))

#Calculate recording effort 
recordings <- data@files$recordings %>%
  mutate(DriftName = stringr::str_extract(file, "CalCurCEAS_\\d{3}"))

recordings_unique <- recordings %>%
  distinct(file, .keep_all = TRUE)

effort_deployment <- recordings_unique %>%
  group_by(DriftName) %>%
  summarise(
    recording_hours = sum(length, na.rm = TRUE) / 3600,
    n_files = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

## Total recording effort
effort_total <- effort_deployment %>%
  summarise(
    n_drifts = n(),
    recording_hours = sum(recording_hours),
    recording_days = recording_hours / 24)

#Encounter rates
encounters <-detections %>%
  group_by(eventId) %>%
  summarise(
    DriftName = first(.data$DriftName),
    species = first(.data$species),
    encounter_start = min(.data$UTC, na.rm = TRUE),
    encounter_end = max(.data$UTC, na.rm = TRUE),
    encounter_duration_min = as.numeric(
      difftime(encounter_end, encounter_start, units = "mins")
    ),
    n_clicks = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

encounter_rates <- encounters %>%
  count(DriftName, name = "n_encounters") %>%
  right_join(effort_deployment, by = "DriftName") %>%
  mutate(
    n_encounters = tidyr::replace_na(n_encounters, 0),
    encounters_per_24h = n_encounters / recording_hours * 24)

overall_encounter_rate <- nrow(encounters) /
  sum(effort_deployment$recording_hours) * 24

##Sort drifts by encounter rates 
#arrange(encounter_rates, desc(encounters_per_24h))

#Identify mixed species groups
# 1. Group encounters that occur within 20 min of one another
encounters_grouped <- encounters %>%
  arrange(DriftName, encounter_start) %>%
  group_by(DriftName) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_min = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        encounter_start,
        lag(encounter_end),
        units = "mins"
      )
    ),
    new_encounter_group = is.na(gap_min) | gap_min > 20,
    encounter_group = cumsum(new_encounter_group)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 2. Summarize each encounter group
mixed_encounters <- encounters_grouped %>%
  group_by(DriftName, encounter_group) %>%
  summarise(
    group_start = min(encounter_start),
    group_end = max(encounter_end),
    n_encounters = n(),
    n_species = n_distinct(species),
    species_present = paste(
      sort(unique(species)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    encounter_ids = paste(eventId, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mixed_species = n_species > 1)


# 3. Summarize mixed-species encounters by drift
mixed_by_drift <- mixed_encounters %>%
  group_by(DriftName) %>%
  summarise(
    n_encounter_groups = n(),
    n_mixed_encounters = sum(mixed_species),
    percent_mixed = 100 * n_mixed_encounters / n_encounter_groups,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mixed_summary <- mixed_by_drift %>%
  summarise(
    total_encounters = sum(n_encounter_groups),
    total_mixed = sum(n_mixed_encounters),
    percent_mixed = round(100 * total_mixed / total_encounters, digits=0),
    drifts_with_mixed = sum(n_mixed_encounters > 0),
    max_mixed_per_drift = max(n_mixed_encounters)
  )

# #sort by number of mixed encounters
# arrange(mixed_by_drift, desc(n_mixed_encounters))

#beaked whales with dolphins
dolphin_comments<-readRDS(here('_data','BeakedWhales','BW_Dolphin_summary.rds'))

#count unique encounters
dolphin_summary <- dolphin_comments  %>%
  summarise(
    n_encounters = n_distinct(encounterId),
    n_drifts = n_distinct(DriftName))

species_summary <- detections_summary %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    `Acoustic events` = n(),
    `Total drifts` = length(unique(DriftName)),
    `Min_Dur` = round(min(Duration_min),1),
    `Max_Dur` = round(max(Duration_min),1),
    `Median event duration (min)` = round(median(Duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    `Q1_Dur` = round(quantile(Duration_min,.25)),
    `Q3_Dur` = round(quantile(Duration_min,.75)),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Acoustic events`))

#Report percentile rank of specific latitudes using empirical cumulative distribution function
#Latitude 37 is approximately San Francisco

Hubbs <- detections_summary %>% 
  filter(species=="HUBW") 
HubbsLatECDF<-ecdf(Hubbs$Latitude)

#Percentile of Hubbs detections less than 37 degrees
HubbsLatECDF(37)*100 

Stej <- detections_summary %>% 
  filter(species=="STBWH") 
StejLatECDF<-ecdf(Stej$Latitude)

#Percentile of Stejneger's detections less than 37 degrees
StejLatECDF(37)*100 

#Evaluate depth distributions
depth_summary<- detections_summary %>% 
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    `Acoustic events` = n(),
    `Min_Depth` = round(min(bottom_depth_m),1),
    `Max_Depth` = round(max(bottom_depth_m),1),
    `Median Depth` = round(median(bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    `Q1_Depth` = round(quantile(bottom_depth_m,.25)),
    `Q3_Depth` = round(quantile(bottom_depth_m,.75)),
    .groups = "drop")  
depth_summary

#Remove GTBW since there is only one event
detections_summary_Stat<-filter(detections_summary,species!="GTBW")

#Dunn's test (designed as post-hoc multiple-comparison procuedure following Kruskal-Wallis and handles unqueal sample sizes naturally)
dunnTest(
  bottom_depth_m~species,
  data =detections_summary_Stat,
  method="bh")
```

## Overall beaked whale presence

There were `r length(unique(detections_summary$eventId))` total beaked whale events detected on `r length(unique(detections_summary$DriftName))` separate drifts, corresponding to an overall encounter rate of `r overall_encounter_rate` encounters per 24 hours of recording. Encounter rates varied among individual drifts, ranging from 0-6.9 encounters per 24 hours (median = 1.9, IQR = \[0.9-4.1\]. The highest encounter rates were observed during drifts 10 (6.9 encounters per 24 h), drift 22 (6.7 encounters per 24 h), and drift 9 (6.2 encounters per 24 h), while drifts 12, 13, and 14 contained zero beaked whale acoustic detections.

Five distinct beaked whale species were acoustically detected, including goose-beaked, Hubb's, Stejneger's, Baird's, and gingko-toothed beaked whales (@tbl-species-detections). Encounters with multiple beaked whales were relatively uncommon, comprising `r mixed_summary$total_mixed` of `r mixed_summary$total_encounters` encounters (`r mixed_summary$percent_mixed` %). Mixed-species of beaked whale encounters occurred on `r mixed_summary$drifts_with_mixed` drifts, with 0-`r mixed_summary$max_mixed_per_drift` mixed species encounters per drift. The greatest numbers of mixed species were observed on drifts 9 (7 encounters) and drift 10 (7 encounters).

Analyst comments noted dolphins at the surface during `r dolphin_summary$n_encounters` beaked whale encounters across `r dolphin_summary$n_drifts` drifts. Because these observations were recorded opportunistically during acoustic review rather than through a standardized protocol, they are reported as incidental observations rather than as a rate or proportion of encounters.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-species-detections

species_summary_pub <- detections_summary %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    `Acoustic events` = n(),
    `Total duration (min)` = round(sum(Duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    `Median event duration (min)` = round(median(Duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    `Total clicks` = sum(n_clicks, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = recode(
      species,
      "BBWH"  = "*Berardius bairdii*",
      "GOBW"  = "*Ziphius cavirostris*",
      "HUBW"  = "*Mesoplodon carlhubbsi*",
      "GTBW"  = "*Mesoplodon ginkgodens*",
      "STBWH" = "*Mesoplodon stejnegeri*", 
      "UNME"  = "Unidentified beaked whale"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species,
    `Acoustic events`,
    `Total duration (min)`,
    `Median event duration (min)`,
    `Total clicks`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Species)

knitr::kable(
  species_summary_pub,
  caption = "Summary of beaked whale acoustic events by species.",
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
)
```

![](/_figs/beaked_whales/CalCurCEAS_bw_FullMap_ZC.png){width="224"} ![](/_figs/beaked_whales/CalCurCEAS_bw_FullMap_BB.png){width="224"} ![](/_figs/beaked_whales/CalCurCEAS_bw_FullMap_BW.png){width="224"}

Bottom depth at acoustic encounters differed among species (Kruskal-Wallis: χ²(3) = 120.71, *p* \< 0.001). Goose-beaked whale encounters occurred at the greatest median depth (3,679 m; IQR=3,182-4,178 m), compared with Baird's (3,123 m; IQR=2,639-3,516 m), Stejneger's (2,984 m; IQR=2,725-3,135 m) and Hubbs' beaked whales (2,914 m; IQR=2,735-3,141 m). Post-hoc Dunn tests with Benjamini–Hochberg correction indicated significant differences between goose-beaked and Baird's beaked whales (*p =* 0.0017), goose-beaked and Hubbs' beaked whales (*p\<*0.001), and goose-beaked and Stejneger's beaked whales (*p\<*0.001). No significant differences were detected among Baird's, Hubbs' and Stejneger's beaked whales (all adjusted *p≥* 0.47)*.* The single gingko-toothed beaked whale encounter occurred over a bottom depth of 4,082 m, but was excluded from statistical comparisons because only one encounter was detected.

![](/_figs/beaked_whales/CalCurCEAS_bw_DepthDist.png){width="500"}

No significant differences in acoustic event rates between day and night were detected for any species. Day rate ratios were 1.20 for GOBW (95% CI = 1.00–1.44, *p* = 0.051), 1.09 for BBWH (95% CI = 0.44–2.72, *p* = 0.848), 1.08 for HUBW (95% CI = 0.70–1.66, *p* = 0.733), and 0.78 for STBWH (95% CI = 0.47–1.30, *p* = 0.340). Baird's beaked whales had a substantially greater uncertainty because of the smaller number of encounters.

## Goose-beaked whales

Goose-beaked whales were the most abundant and wide-spread beaked whale species acoustically detected in this study. Overall, there were 468 goose-beaked whale encounters identified on 21 drifts, with encounter durations ranging from 1-80 minutes (median=13, IQR= 2-25).

## Hubbs' beaked whales

Hubb's beaked whales were the second most common beaked whale species acoustically detected in this study. Overall there were 84 acoustic encounters identified on 13 drifts, with encounter durations ranging from 1-80 minutes (median=10, IQR=4-16). Hubbs' beaked whales were predominantly detected in the northern California Current, with 98% (n=82) of encounters detected north of San Francisco, CA (roughly latitude 37.77°N.

## Stejneger's beaked whales

Stejneger's beaked whales were the third most common beaked whale species acoustically detected in this study. Overall there were 65 acoustic encounters identified on 12 drifts, with encounter durations ranging from 1-86 minutes (median=10, IQR=6-13). Stejneger's beaked whales were predominantly detected in the northern California Current, with 97% (n=63) of encounters detected north of San Francisco, CA (roughly latitude 37.77°N).

## Baird's beaked whales

Baird's beaked whales were detected in 19 acoustic encounters on 13 drifts, with encounter durations ranging from 1-124 minutes (median=10, IQR=5-20). Baird's beaked whales were detected throughout the California Current.

## Gingko-toothed beaked whales

There was one acoustic detection of gingko-toothed whales that was 13.4 minutes in duration. This event was detected on drift 27, in the southern extent of the study offshore of the Southern California Bight (roughly latitude 33°N). During this encounter, there were concurrent echolocation clicks detected in separate click trains from goose-beaked whales at depth and delphinid echolocation clicks in the upper water column.
